Hi all,

Finance/procurement has reviewed the request and can approve a conditional, temporary carve-out for pilots under $5,000 provided the following controls are in place: 

- Completed procurement-carveout-form (attached).
- W9 on file (received).
- Vendor attestations: liability insurance minimum limits OR acceptance of a liability cap in the addendum.
- One-off invoice addendum signed (DocuSign) that states pilot is invoice-only and production will require standard PO onboarding.
- A spending cap of $5,000 for the pilot and written confirmation of the spend cadence (one-time vs monthly).

If StreamCore agrees, we will onboard them as a temporary vendor with Net 30 terms. After the pilot concludes we will either convert them to full vendor (PO) or close the temporary account. Please note we reserve the right to require a PO for any charge above the cap.

I've attached the procurement-carveout-form. Next steps for Camila/Ben: confirm the spend cadence and have StreamCore sign the addendum. Once the addendum is executed, finance will route AP access and create a temporary vendor record.
